description: This file defines the Settings controller for the Coocook web application, handling user settings related actions such as viewing and updating account information, changing passwords, managing organizations and projects.

classes.name: Coocook::Controller::Settings
classes.description: Controller class managing user settings actions in the Coocook web application.

methods.name: base
methods.description: Sets up common data for all settings-related actions, including submenu items.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Redirects to the account settings page.

methods.name: account
methods.description: Displays account settings, including email change options and URLs for profile management.

methods.name: change_display_name
methods.description: Handles POST request to change the user's display name.

methods.name: change_password
methods.description: Handles POST request to change the user's password, with validation and session management.

methods.name: organizations
methods.description: Displays organizations the user belongs to, with options to leave or create new ones.

methods.name: projects
methods.description: Displays projects associated with the user.

methods.name: redirect
methods.description: Private method to add a message and redirect to the index page.
